title: Pure Guardragon
summary: Guardragon cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. The page treats Guardragon as an engine for Dragon decks, and its two key Links, Guardragon Elpy and Guardragon Agarpain, are Forbidden. What remains still runs as a small Dragon deck that feeds on Normal Monsters going to the GY. Guardragon Justicia is a Level 2 Normal Tuner. Guardragon Corewakening calls it from the Deck, and when it becomes Link material for Guardragon Pisty, Guardragon Garmides summons itself from the hand and Guardragon Promineses comes back from the GY. Pisty then revives any Dragon into a zone two Links point to. Revived that way, Guardragon Andrake destroys a monster. World Legacy Guardragon Mardark summons itself by banishing two Normals and shrinks their monsters per Dragon you control. World Chalice Guardragon negates an effect that targets your linked monster. Pisty locks you to Dragon summons.
